records.isnad_en: By the same chain as report 184: from 'Ubayd Allah b. 'Umar al-'Umari, from Nafi', from 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar, that:
records.matn_en: that the Prophet ﷺ forbade selling food when one of you has bought it until he has taken full possession of it.
flags: Chain inherited from previous report by wa bihi

records.isnad_ar: عَنِ الْحَجَّاجِ بْنِ الْحَجَّاجِ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: «
records.matn_ar: الْأَخِلَّاءُ ثَلَاثَةٌ: فَأَمَّا خَلِيلٌ، فَيَقُولُ: لَكَ مَا أَعْطَيْتَهُ، وَمَا أَمْسَكْتَ فَلَيْسَ لَكَ، ذَلِكَ مَالُهُ، وَأَمَّا خَلِيلٌ ، فَيَقُولُ: أَنَا مَعَكَ حَتَّى تَأْتِيَ بَابَ الْمَلِكِ، ثُمَّ أَرْجِعُ وَأَتْرُكُكَ، وَذَلِكَ أَهْلُهُ وَعَشِيرَتُهُ يُشَيِّعُونُهُ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ قَبْرَهُ، ثُمَّ يَرْجِعُونَ وَيَتْرُكُونَهُ، وَأَمَّا خَلِيلٌ، فَيَقُولُ: أَنَا مَعَكُ حَيْثُ دَخَلْتَ، وَحَيْثُ خَرَجْتَ، فَذَلِكَ عَمَلُهُ، فَيَقُولُ: وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ كُنْتَ مِنْ أَهْوَنِ الثَّلَاثَةِ عَلَيَّ»
records.isnad_en: From al-Hajjaj b. al-Hajjaj, from Qatada, from Anas b. Malik, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Friends are three: one friend says: 'Yours is what you gave, and what you withheld is not yours'; that is his wealth. Another friend says: 'I am with you until you reach the door of the king, then I return and leave you'; that is his family and his clan, who escort him until he reaches his grave, then return and leave him. And another friend says: 'I am with you wherever you enter and wherever you go out'; that is his deed. He says: 'By God, I held you the lightest of the three.'”

records.isnad_ar: عَنِ الْحَجَّاجِ بْنِ الْحَجَّاجِ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ جُنْدُبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «
records.matn_ar: مَنْ صَلَّى الْغَدَاةَ فَهُوَ فِي ذِمَّةِ اللَّهِ، فَلَا يَطْلُبَنَّكُمُ اللَّهُ بِشَيْءٍ مِنْ ذِمَّتِهِ»
records.isnad_en: From al-Hajjaj b. al-Hajjaj, from Qatada, from al-Hasan, from Jundab b. 'Abd Allah, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Whoever prays the morning prayer is in God's protection, so let God not seek from you anything of His protection.”

records.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبَانَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ أُنَاسًا، قَالُوا: يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، مَا يَمْنَعُكَ أَنْ تَرْغَبَ، فِيمَا يَرْغَبُ فِيهِ النَّاسُ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْإِمَارَةِ؟ قَالَ: أَبْعَدُ قَوْلِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ سَلَّمَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: إِنَّ «الرَّجُلَ لَيُحَاسَبُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ حَتَّى يُسْأَلَ عَنْ وَلَدِهِ، وَزَوْجَتِهِ» فَمَا رَغِبْتُ فِيمَا بَعْدَ هَذَا
records.isnad_en: From Aban b. Abi 'Ayyash, from Nafi', from 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar:
records.matn_en: that some people said: “O Abu 'Abd al-Rahman, what prevents you from desiring what people desire of this leadership?” He said: “After the Messenger of God's words ﷺ: 'A man will be called to account on the Day of Resurrection until he is asked about his child and his wife'? I have not desired anything after this.”

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar (Companion), reporting the Prophet ﷺ (mixed)

records.isnad_ar: عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ الْأَنْصَارِيِّ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي بَيْتٍ فَقَالَ: «إِنَّ هَذَا الْأَمْرَ لَا يَزَالُ فِيكُمْ وَأَنْتُمْ وُلَاتُهُ مَا لَمْ تُحْدِثُوا عَمَلًا يَنْزِعُهُ اللَّهُ فِيكُمْ، فَإِذَا فَعَلْتُمْ ذَلِكَ، سَلَّطَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ شِرَارَ خَلْقِهِ فَالْتَحَوْكُمْ كَمَا يُلْتَحَى الْقَضِيبُ»
records.isnad_en: From al-Hasan, from Habib b. Abi Thabit, from al-Qasim b. Muhammad b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. al-Harith b. Hisham, from 'Ubayd Allah b. 'Abd Allah b. 'Utba b. Mas'ud, from Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari, who said:
records.matn_en: We were with the Messenger of God ﷺ in a house, and he said: “This matter will remain among you and you will be its custodians so long as you do not introduce a deed that God removes from you; when you do that, God will set over you the worst of His creation, who will strip you as a stick is stripped of its bark.”

narrators.en: 'Ubayd Allah b. 'Abd Allah b. 'Utba b. Mas'ud
narrators.ar: عبيد الله بن عبد الله بن عتبه بن مسعود

narrators.en: al-Qasim b. Muhammad b. 'Abd al-Rahman b. al-Harith b. Hisham
narrators.ar: القاسم بن محمد بن عبد الرحمن بن الحارث بن هشام

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: The Prophet ﷺ (account by Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari) (prophetic)

records.isnad_ar: عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، أَنَّهُ حَدَّثَ
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رُفِعَتْ إِلَيْهِ امْرَأَةٌ تَطْلُبُ مِيرَاثَهَا مِنْ دِيَةِ زَوْجِهَا، فَقَالَ عُمَرُ: إِنَّمَا الدِّيَةُ لِلْعَاقِلَةِ فَلَا أَعْلَمُ لَكِ شَيْئًا. فَقَالَ الضَّحَّاكُ بْنُ سُفْيَانَ: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ كَتَبَ إِلَيَّ أَنْ «أُوَرِّثَ امْرَأَةَ أَشْيَمَ الضِّبَابِيِّ مِنْ دِيَةِ زَوْجِهَا» فَوَرَّثَهَا عُمَرُ "
records.isnad_en: From Muhammad b. Maysara, from al-Zuhri, from Ibn al-Musayyab:
records.matn_en: that a woman was brought before 'Umar b. al-Khattab, asking for her inheritance from the blood-money of her husband. 'Umar said: “The blood-money belongs only to the 'aqila [the paternal kin group]; I know nothing for you.” Al-Dahhak b. Sufyan said: “I bear witness that the Messenger of God ﷺ wrote to me: 'Let the wife of Ashyam al-Dibabi inherit from the blood-money of her husband.'” So 'Umar gave her the inheritance.

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: 'Umar b. al-Khattab and al-Dahhak b. Sufyan (Companions), reporting a letter of the Prophet ﷺ (mixed)

records.isnad_ar: عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ
records.matn_ar: أَنَّهُ، اخْتَصَمَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي امْرَأَةٍ رَمَتْ أُخْرَى وَهِيَ حُبْلَى، فَأَسْقَطَتْ، «فَقَضَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فِي جَنِينِهَا غُرَّةٌ عَبْدٌ أَوْ أَمَةٌ»
records.isnad_en: From 'Abd al-'Aziz b. 'Abd Allah b. Abi Salama, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Salama, from Abu Hurayra:
records.matn_en: that a dispute was brought to the Messenger of God ﷺ about a woman who struck another while she was pregnant, so that she miscarried; the Messenger of God ﷺ ruled regarding her fetus a ghurra: a male or female slave.

narrators.en: 'Abd al-'Aziz b. 'Abd Allah b. Abi Salama
narrators.ar: عبد العزيز بن عبد الله بن ابي سلمه

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: The Prophet ﷺ (account by Abu Hurayra) (prophetic)

records.isnad_ar: عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ يَوْمَ فَتْحِ مَكَّةَ: «
records.matn_ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ، صَدَقَ وَعْدَهُ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ»
records.isnad_en: From Khalid al-Hadhdha', from al-Qasim b. 'Abd al-Rahman, from 'Uqba b. 'Amir, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said on the day of the conquest of Mecca:
records.matn_en: “There is no god but God alone; He fulfilled His promise, gave victory to His servant, and defeated the confederates alone.”

records.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ أَبِي تَمِيمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ: "
records.matn_ar: بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ ثَلَاثَمِائَةِ رَجُلٍ وَأَمَّرَ عَلَيْهِمْ أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ بْنَ الْجَرَّاحِ، قَالَ: وَزَوَّدَهُمْ جِرَابَ تَمْرٍ، فَكَانَ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ يَرْزُقُهُمْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ قَبْضَةً قَبْضَةً كُلَّ رَجُلٍ فَذَكَرَ الْحَدِيثَ
records.isnad_en: From Ayyub b. Abi Tamima, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ sent three hundred men and appointed Abu 'Ubayda b. al-Jarrah over them. He said: He provisioned them with a bag of dates, and Abu 'Ubayda would provide for them, at first, a handful for each man. He mentioned the hadith. [Abbreviated in the source.]

records.isnad_ar: عَنْ حُسَيْنٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ:
records.matn_ar: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَ صَلَاةِ الظُّهْرِ وَالْعَصْرِ فِي السَّفَرِ، إِذَا كَانَ عَلَى ظَهْرِ سَيْرٍ، وَيَجْمَعُ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ»
records.isnad_en: From Husayn, from Yahya b. Abi Kathir, from 'Ikrima, from 'Abd Allah b. 'Abbas, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ would combine the noon and afternoon prayers on a journey, when he was on the move, and combine the sunset and night prayers.

records.isnad_ar: عَنْ حُسَيْنٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَاصِمٍ، عَمَّنْ رَأَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «
records.matn_ar: يُصَلِّي وَفِي رِجْلَيْهِ نَعْلَانِ، فَبَزَقَ فَمَسَحَ بُصَاقَهُ بِنَعْلِهِ فِي التُّرَابِ، وَالْمَسْجِدُ يَوْمَئِذٍ فِيهِ التُّرَابُ»
records.isnad_en: From Husayn, from Yahya b. Abi Kathir, from Muhammad b. Abi 'Asim, from one who saw the Messenger of God ﷺ [not named]:
records.matn_en: praying with sandals on his feet; he spat, then rubbed his spittle with his sandal into the dust, and the mosque then had dust [as its floor].

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: The Prophet ﷺ (account by an unnamed Companion) (prophetic)

records.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِي الْجُوَيْرِيَةِ، عَنْ عَسَلٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «
records.matn_ar: مَا طَلَعَ النَّجْمُ غَدَاةً قَطُّ وَبِقَوْمٍ أَوْ بِقَرْيَةٍ عَاهَةٌ، إِلَّا خَفَّتْ أَوِ ارْتَفَعَتْ عَنْهُمْ» فَقُلْتُ: عَمَّنْ هَذَا يَا أَبَا مُحَمَّدٍ؟ قَالَ: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ
records.isnad_en: From Abu al-Juwayriya, from 'Asal, from 'Ata' b. Abi Rabah, from Abu Hurayra, that he said:
records.matn_en: “The star (al-najm) has never risen in the morning over a people or a town in which there was a blight but it lightened or was lifted from them.” I said: “From whom is this, O Abu Muhammad?” He said: “From Abu Hurayra, from the Messenger of God ﷺ.”

records.isnad_ar: عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ:
records.matn_ar: رَحِمَ اللَّهُ أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُمَرَ إِنَّمَا كَانَتْ جَنَازَةُ يَهُودِيٍّ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «إِنَّهُمْ لَيَبْكُونَ وَإِنَّهُ لَيُعَذَّبُ» وَقَدِ احْتَرَمَ ذَلِكَ .. .
records.isnad_en: From Muhammad b. Ishaq, from Muhammad b. Muslim al-Zuhri, from 'Urwa b. al-Zubayr, from 'A'isha, who said:
records.matn_en: May God have mercy on Abu 'Abd al-Rahman [meaning Ibn 'Umar]: it was only the funeral of a Jew, and the Messenger of God ﷺ said: “They are weeping over him while he is being punished.” And he has respected that ... [text trails off in the source].

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: The Prophet ﷺ (account by 'A'isha, correcting Ibn 'Umar) (prophetic)

records.isnad_ar: عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيِّبِ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ،
records.matn_ar: أَنَّ نَاقَةً لَهُ وَقَعَتْ فِي حَائِطِ قَوْمٍ فَأَفْسَدَتْ فِيهِ «فَقَضَى فِيهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: أَنَّ عَلَى أَهْلِ الْأَمْوَالِ الْحِفْظَ بِالنَّهَارِ وَعَلَى أَهْلِ الْمَوَاشِي الْحِفْظَ بِاللَّيْلِ»
records.isnad_en: From Muhammad b. Maysara, from al-Zuhri, from Sa'id b. al-Musayyab, from al-Bara' b. 'Azib:
records.matn_en: that a she-camel of his had entered the orchard of some people and damaged it, so the Messenger of God ﷺ ruled concerning it that the owners of orchards must guard by day, and the owners of livestock must guard by night.

extra_refs.label: Reported authority
extra_refs.value: The Prophet ﷺ (account by al-Bara' b. 'Azib) (prophetic)

records.isnad_ar: عَنْ أَبِي هَارُونَ الْعَبْدِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: إِنِّي «
records.matn_ar: أُتِيتُ بِدَابَّةٍ أَشْبَهُ الدَّوَابِّ بِالْبَغْلِ، مُضْطَرِبُ الْأُذُنَيْنِ، يَضَعُ خُطْوَةً عِنْدَ مُنْتَهَى طَرْفِهِ» فَذَكَرَ حَدِيثَ الْمِعْرَاجِ "
records.isnad_en: From Abu Harun al-'Abdi, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “I was brought a mount most like a mule, with quivering ears, that places its stride at the limit of its sight.” He mentioned the hadith of the Mi'raj. [Abbreviated in the source.]

records.isnad_ar: عَنِ السَّرِيِّ بْنِ يَحْيَى، عَنِ يحيى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَّامٍ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ الْأَشْعَرِيِّ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «
records.matn_ar: أُمِرَ يَحْيَى بْنُ زَكَرِيَّا بِخَمْسٍ؛ لِيَعْمَلَ بِهِنَّ، وَيَأْمُرَ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَنْ يَعْمَلُوا بِهِنَّ» الْحَدِيثَ
records.isnad_en: From al-Sari b. Yahya, from Yahya b. Abi Kathir, from Abu Sallam, from al-Harith al-Ash'ari, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Yahya b. Zakariyya was commanded to [observe] five [things], to act by them and to command the Children of Israel to act by them.” [The hadith continues; abbreviated in the source.]

records.isnad_ar: عَنِ الْحَجَّاجِ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلَابَةَ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «
records.matn_ar: تُحْشَرُ نَارٌ مِنْ حَضْرَمَوْتَ تَحْشُرُ النَّاسَ» . قَالُوا: بِمَ تَأْمُرُنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ؟ قَالَ: «عَلَيْكُمُ الشَّامَ»
records.isnad_en: From al-Hajjaj, from Yahya b. Abi Kathir, from Abu Qilaba, from Salim, from his father (not named in the text), who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “A fire will gather forth from Hadramawt, driving people.” They said: “What do you command us, O Messenger of God?” He said: “Hold to al-Sham.”

narrators.en: His father (not named in the text)

records.isnad_ar: عَنِ الْحَجَّاجِ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ مَعْدَانَ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «
records.matn_ar: مَنْ حَفِظَ مِنْ أَوَّلِ سُورَةِ الْكَهْفِ عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ عُصِمَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدَّجَّالِ»
records.isnad_en: From al-Hajjaj, from Qatada, from Salim b. Abi al-Ja'd, from Ma'dan b. Abi Talha, from Abu al-Darda', who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Whoever memorizes ten verses from the beginning of Surat al-Kahf will be protected from the trial of the Dajjal.”

records.isnad_ar: عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «
records.matn_ar: مَنْ شَرِبَ الْخَمْرَ فِي الدُّنْيَا لَمْ يَشْرَبْهَا فِي الْآخِرَةِ إِلَّا أَنْ يَتُوبَ»
records.isnad_en: From Musa b. 'Uqba, from Nafi', from 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “Whoever drinks wine in this world will not drink it in the Hereafter, unless he repents.”

records.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «
records.matn_ar: إِذَا كَانَ أَحَدُكُمْ عَلَى طَعَامِهِ، فَلَا يَعْجَلَنَّ عَنْهُ حَتَّى يَقْضِيَ حَاجَتَهُ مِنْهُ، وَإِنْ أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلَاةُ»
records.isnad_en: By the same chain as report 203: from Musa b. 'Uqba, from Nafi', from 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “When one of you is at his meal, let him not hurry away from it until he has finished his need of it, even if the prayer is called.”
flags: Chain inherited from previous report by wa bihi

records.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ﷺ «
records.matn_ar: أَمَرَ بِزَكَاةِ الْفِطْرِ أَنْ تُؤَدَّى قَبْلَ خُرُوجِ النَّاسِ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ»
records.isnad_en: By the same chain as report 203: from Musa b. 'Uqba, from Nafi', from 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar, that:
records.matn_en: that the Messenger of God ﷺ ordered that zakat al-fitr be paid before the people go out to the prayer.
flags: Chain inherited from previous report by wa bihi

records.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ: «
records.matn_ar: الْبَيِّعَانِ بِالْخِيَارِ مِنْ بَيْعِهِمَا مَا لَمْ يَتَفَرَّقَا، أَوْ يَكُونُ بَيْعُهُمَا عَنْ خِيَارٍ، فَإِذَا كَانَ بَيْعُهُمَا عَنْ خِيَارٍ فَقَدْ وَجَبَ الْبَيْعُ أَوْ يَتَفَرَّقَا»
records.isnad_en: By the same chain as report 203: from Musa b. 'Uqba, from Nafi', from 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ said:
records.matn_en: “The two parties to a sale have the option regarding their sale as long as they have not separated, or if their sale was with an option; if their sale was with an option, the sale is binding – or they separate.”
flags: Chain inherited from previous report by wa bihi

records.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ قَالَ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ «
records.matn_ar: يَعْتَكِفُ الْعَشْرَ الْأَوَائِلَ مِنْ رَمَضَانَ»
records.isnad_en: By the same chain as report 203: from Musa b. 'Uqba, from Nafi', from 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar, who said:
records.matn_en: The Messenger of God ﷺ used to observe i'tikaf during the first ten [days] of Ramadan.
flags: Chain inherited from previous report by wa bihi

records.isnad_ar: وَبِهِ أَنَّهُ قَالَ: «
records.matn_ar: إِنَّ الْيَهُودَ جَاءُوا بِرَجُلٍ مِنْهُمْ وَامْرَأَةٍ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ﷺ قَدْ زَنَيَا، فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ:» فَمَا تَجِدُونَ فِي التَّوْرَاةِ؟ «فَقَالُوا: لَا نَجِدُ شَيْئًا. فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَلَامٍ: كَذَبْتُمْ، فِي التَّوْرَاةِ الرَّجْمُ، فَأْتُوا بِالتَّوْرَاةِ فَاتْلُوهَا إِنْ كُنْتُمْ صَادِقِينَ. فَجَاءُوا بِالتَّوْرَاةِ، فَوَضَعُوهَا، فَوَضَعَ مِدْرَاسُهَا الَّذِي يَدْرُسُهَا مِنْهُمْ كَفَّهُ عَلَى آيَةِ الرَّجْمِ، فَطَفِقَ يَقْرَأُ مَا دُونَ يَدِهِ وَمَا وَرَاءَهَا، وَلَا يَقْرَأُ آيَةَ الرَّجْمِ، قَالَ: فَنَزَعَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَلَامٍ يَدَهُ عَنْ آيَةِ الرَّجْمِ، فَقَالَ: مَا هَذِهِ؟ فَلَمَّا رَأَوْا ذَلِكَ، قَالَ: هِيَ آيَةُ الرَّجْمِ. قَالَ:» فَأَمَرَ بِهِمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ﷺ فَرُجِمَا قَرِيبًا مِنْ حَيْثُ يُوضَعُ الْجَنَائِزُ عِنْدَ الْمَسْجِدِ " فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ: فَرَأَيْتُ الرَّجُلَ يَحْنَأُ عَلَيْهَا يَقِيهَا الْحِجَارَةَ
records.isnad_en: By the same chain as report 203: from Musa b. 'Uqba, from Nafi', from 'Abd Allah b. 'Umar, that he said:
records.matn_en: “The Jews brought to the Messenger of God ﷺ a man and a woman of theirs who had committed adultery. The Messenger of God ﷺ said to them: 'What do you find in the Torah?' They said: 'We find nothing.' 'Abd Allah b. Salam said: 'You lie; in the Torah is stoning. Bring the Torah and recite it, if you are truthful.' They brought the Torah and spread it; the scholar among them who studies it placed his palm over the verse of stoning and began to read what was before his hand and after it, not reading the verse of stoning. 'Abd Allah b. Salam pulled his hand off the verse of stoning and said: 'What is this?' When they saw that, he said: 'It is the verse of stoning.' He said: The Messenger of God ﷺ ordered the two to be stoned, near where the funerals are placed by the mosque.” 'Abd Allah said: I saw the man bending over her, shielding her from the stones.
flags: Chain inherited from previous report by wa bihi
